info.name: Medibook API (v1)
info.description:
Contract for the patient app, hospital web app, display screens and ops console (Q140).

Generated from the OpenAPI schema by `manage.py postman_export` — regenerate instead of editing. Select the **Medibook dev** environment; every seeded account's password is `seed_password_123` (var/seed/users.json). Dev uses a self-signed certificate: SSL verification is off for this collection.

exec: // Medibook: bearer token per namespace, logged in on demand from the environment's credentials.
const ns = m[1] === 'shared' ? 'patient' : m[1];  // shared file/export routes: as the patient
console.warn('Medibook auto-login failed for ' + ns, err || res.text());

item.name: Patient

request.description: GET /patient/ambulance/providers?city&area&hospital_id (v1 §7.2.3; platform-curated, Q125–126).
GET/POST /patient/appointments. POST is the booking: one 5-minute timer (§5.3).
GET/POST /patient/appointments. POST is the booking: one 5-minute timer (§5.3).

GET /patient/appointments/{id} (v1 §7.2.4): detail incl. payment, receipt, refunds and the
actions the patient may take. No reschedule (D-14).

GET /patient/appointments/{id}/calendar.ics — add-to-calendar (CM-27). The body carries only
human-readable numbers (booking_ref, token) — never a UUID (Q43).

POST /patient/appointments/{id}/cancel {reason} → {appointment, refunds} (v2 §7.1, §5.5).
Idempotency-Key required (D-21). Token rules: TOKEN_ALREADY_CALLED / TOKEN_CANCEL_WINDOW_CLOSED
(Q23). There is no reschedule (D-14): the app offers "Book again".

GET /patient/appointments/{id}/cancellation-preview → {allowed, cutoff_at, refund_bp,
refund_paise, includes_convenience_fee, reason} (v2 §5.5; two tiers, Q84).
GET /patient/appointments/{id}/events — history (v1 §7.2.4).

GET /patient/appointments/{id}/queue → {session_state, current_token, last_called_token,
your_token, tokens_ahead, estimated_wait_minutes, updated_at} (v2 §7.1; Q29).
GET /patient/appointments/{id}/receipt — JSON receipt (v1 §7.2.4; D-22, Q98).
GET /patient/appointments/{id}/receipt.pdf → {url} signed PDF URL (v1 §7.2.4).

POST /patient/appointments/{id}/review {rating, comment} — after ``completed`` only, one per
appointment; enters moderation when ``review_moderation_required`` (Q77).

GET /patient/appointments/{id}/token-card → {booking_ref, token_label, qr_payload, hospital,
doctor, date/time, session} (v1 §7.2.4, CM-15; QR = booking_ref).
POST /patient/auth/login/otp/start — same response for unknown numbers, never sent.
POST /patient/auth/login/otp/verify → tokens. Reactivates an account in cooling-off (D-24).

POST /patient/auth/login/password — only accounts with a password set (v2 §7.1).
401 AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS {attempts_remaining} · 423 AUTH_LOCKED_OUT {locked_until} (Q52).
POST /<surface>/auth/logout → 204; revokes the calling session.

POST /<surface>/auth/logout-all → 204. v1 §5.1: "``logout-all`` revokes every session of
the user" — every surface, not only the calling one (audit D-08).
POST /patient/auth/otp/resend — same challenge id, fresh code; 3 per 15 min (D-23) → 429.
POST /patient/auth/password/forgot/start → challenge (same shape for unknown accounts).
POST /patient/auth/password/forgot/verify → {reset_token, expires_at} (15 min).

POST /<surface>/auth/password/reset {reset_token, new_password} → 204; applies the one
password policy and revokes every session (v1 §5.1). On the platform surface it also activates
a newly created staff member setting their first password.
GET /<surface>/auth/sessions — the caller's live sessions on this surface.
DELETE /<surface>/auth/sessions/{id} → 204; only the caller's own sessions.

token revokes the whole family (``rotation_reuse``) → 401 AUTH_SESSION_REVOKED; the refresh
token's principal must match the surface (D-10). Mounted on patient, hospital and platform.

POST /hospital/appointments/{id}/approve — pending_approval → scheduled (Q90).

POST /hospital/appointments/{id}/cancel {reason} — hospital cancel, 100% refund including
the convenience fee (Q11), per line to the original method (Q95). No reschedule (D-14).

GET /hospital/appointments/{id}/events — the append-only history.

prepaid, there is no pay-at-hospital (Q89).
GET /hospital/appointments/{id}/receipt (JSON).

GET /hospital/appointments/{id}/receipt.pdf → ``{url}`` (a signed URL, v1 §5.6). The PDF is
rendered on issue by the worker (``receipt.issued`` → render_receipt_pdf) with a synchronous
fallback here; ``501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED_YET`` when this process cannot render PDFs.

POST /hospital/appointments/{id}/refunds {reason} — full only (Q94), one refund per payment
line to its original method (Q95, O-09 default); a cash line is handed back from the acting
staff's open cash session (409 CASH_SESSION_REQUIRED otherwise).

POST /hospital/appointments/{id}/reject {reason} — a hospital cancellation with a 100%
refund including the convenience fee (Q90, Q11).
GET /hospital/appointments/{id}/token-slip (JSON).

GET /hospital/appointments/{id}/token-slip.pdf — rendered from the hospital's default
token_slip print template (payments.services.pdf). ``501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED_YET`` when this
process cannot render PDFs (WeasyPrint libraries missing).

POST /hospital/auth/login {email, password} → tokens (principal hospital, the member's one
hospital, Q58). Lockout as §5.1 (Q52). MFA is off (Q64) so no ``mfa_challenge`` is returned.
Login is never cut off by read-only mode (D-30).

``/auth/mfa/verify`` and ``/me/mfa/{enroll,confirm,disable}`` on the hospital and platform

and the flag ``MFA_ENABLED`` is false, so these are honest stubs → 501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED_YET
(v1 §7.1 "Honest stubs"). Enabling the flag without building the flow still answers 501.

POST /hospital|platform/auth/password/forgot {email} → 202, always (no enumeration). A reset
link is emailed (outbox ``user.password_reset_requested``) only to an active staff member.

POST /<surface>/auth/password/reset {reset_token, new_password} → 204; applies the one
password policy and revokes every session (v1 §5.1). On the platform surface it also activates

GET /<surface>/auth/sessions — the caller's live sessions on this surface.
DELETE /<surface>/auth/sessions/{id} → 204; only the caller's own sessions.

token revokes the whole family (``rotation_reuse``) → 401 AUTH_SESSION_REVOKED; the refresh
token's principal must match the surface (D-10). Mounted on patient, hospital and platform.

item.name: Webhooks

request.description:
POST /webhooks/email/ses — SNS-signed (certificate host ``sns.<region>.amazonaws.com`` over
https, signature over the canonical string). Bounces / complaints → suppression_list. Staff
email only (patients never receive email).

POST /webhooks/razorpay — optional source-IP allowlist (``RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_IPS``, empty =
disabled, v1 §10), then HMAC-SHA256 ``X-Razorpay-Signature`` over the raw body
(constant-time); idempotent on ``X-Razorpay-Event-Id``. Rejections are recorded with
``signature_valid = False`` and never processed (P-15).

POST /webhooks/sms/msg91 — delivery receipts. IP allowlist (``MSG91_WEBHOOK_IPS``, via the one
``client_ip()``) + HMAC over the raw body with ``MSG91_WEBHOOK_SECRET`` (v1 §7.5).

GET /webhooks/whatsapp — subscription verification (verify token, constant-time).
POST — status receipts / inbound (logged only), ``X-Hub-Signature-256`` over the raw body.

GET /webhooks/whatsapp — subscription verification (verify token, constant-time).
POST — status receipts / inbound (logged only), ``X-Hub-Signature-256`` over the raw body.
